extras: Desktop only; text color in footnotes and endnotes and theme-based colors are not preserved on import.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian desktop plugin to import .docx files into your vault as Markdown, and export Markdown notes back to .docx.
motivation: The author developed it because existing methods for importing Google Doc notes failed to preserve all styles and formatting.
problem: Users often struggle to maintain complex formatting and structure when moving content from proprietary document formats into Markdown-based note-taking apps.

relations.evidence: At first, I was trying to import my google doc notes to my vault.

summary: A tool that imports DOCX files into Obsidian as Markdown and exports Markdown notes back to DOCX format.
